Pristin".  Like their labelmate group Seventeen, Pristin is known for writing and composing their own music.
Cupid (band) | Cupid (Hangul: 큐피트) is a Korean pop girl group that currently has four members.  The group debuted on 15 April 2015 with their single album "I Feel Good", released under music label In Entertainment.
